Laurey 52426, Transitional Newport Cabinet Cup Pull in Polished Chrome

The Polished Chrome Newport Cabinet Cup Pull was designed with function and style in mind. This transitional style cabinet bin pull has a rich, Polished Chrome finish. The Laurey 52426 3 Inch Pull Newport in Polished Chrome comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The use of the Newport Cup Pull on your cabinets will be sure to transform your space into a home.

This transitional cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52426 3 Inch Pull Newport Polished Chrome:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1.25"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
